entities.summary: The Diocesan Museum of Amalfi is an art museum housed in the 9th century Basilica del Crocifisso di Amalfi in Amalfi. It displays many of the treasures of the Archdiocese of Amalfi-Cava de' Tirreni and is centrally located close to Amalfi Cathedral in Via Salita Episcopio.
